# Championship pre-season: Custom tab, then the Options, Realism and Controls pages before a season exists
# Generated by scripts/gen-nav-tours.py, each button checked against
# UIData/gtr2ui.mnu. Start on MAIN MENU.
# SEASON TOUR: starts or changes championship progress. Run only with:  gtr2-nav.py path --season-step FILE
# (a plain run refuses). Revert the profile afterwards with git (UserData/<profile>, Championships). 'A=B' = buttons of map page A, screen checked against reference B.
# Format: PAGE | LABEL | EXPECTED PAGE   (a label '@x,y' is a canvas position)
MAIN MENU | APP_BUTTON_GAMEMODESELECT_CHAMPIONSHIP | RESUMEORNEW_CHAMP
RESUMEORNEW_CHAMP | CUSTOM | CUSTOM_CHAMP
CUSTOM_CHAMP | OPTIONS | OPTIONS_BASIC_PRECHAMP
OPTIONS_BASIC_PRECHAMP | VIDEO | OPTIONS_DETAIL_PRECHAMP
OPTIONS_DETAIL_PRECHAMP | AUDIO | OPTIONS_AUDIO_PRECHAMP
OPTIONS_AUDIO_PRECHAMP | ADVANCED | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_PRECHAMP
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_PRECHAMP | REALISM | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_PRECHAMP
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_PRECHAMP | CONTROLS | CONTROL_KEYS_PRECHAMP
CONTROL_KEYS_PRECHAMP | ADVANCED | CONTROL_ONE_PRECHAMP
CONTROL_ONE_PRECHAMP | FORCE | CONTROL_FORCE_PRECHAMP
CONTROL_FORCE_PRECHAMP | BACK | MAIN MENU
